title: Fondue mug movie night
notes: The product is the real Meltie Mug Mini Fondue Mug (red), built into every shot from the store's product photos via keyframes. The original's laptop plays copyrighted series footage and its soundtrack is a copyrighted song; this replica shows people-free cinematic scenes on the laptop (Sora rejects input frames with people) and uses Sora's own audio unless audio.music points to a track you have the rights to. Snacks are unbranded.
style: Vertical smartphone video filmed at night at a home desk, phone about 70 cm away at desk height, WIDE framing showing the whole set: a clean white desk across the bottom quarter; a dark grey open laptop on the left whose bright screen fills the upper-left third; a small Christmas tree with warm fairy lights in the upper-right quarter; a dark wall washed in deep red light across the top. The red Meltie Mini Fondue Mug stands on the desk and is small in frame (about a quarter of the frame tall). Hands have long light-grey manicured nails. Warm, cosy, slightly moody colour grade, realistic, steady handheld. No on-screen text, no logos.
